---
name: security
description: Use when a change touches authentication, authorization, secrets, sensitive data, input handling, encryption, dependency exposure, or privileged operations.
---

# Security

Apply least privilege and explicit trust boundaries.

Review:
- authentication and authorization
- secret storage/rotation
- sensitive-data logging
- input validation and injection risk
- transport/storage protection
- dependency and supply-chain exposure
- privileged operations and auditability

Do not invent a compliance mandate. Security controls can be required by risk even when a named compliance regime is not.
